$comment: Case manifest. Instance files stay pure JSON, so rationale lives here rather than in a $comment property that additionalProperties:false would reject. Invalid cases declare expect_error_contains so a case cannot pass by failing for an unrelated reason.

cases.rationale: Baseline observation under fingerprint policy: digest present, no logical grouping asserted.
Under metadata policy Gyst records that a path exists without reading it. Size is a stat() fact; no digest.
Native Git provenance with git_oid versioning, so ordering is authoritative rather than clock-derived.
The projection form: an artifact block is legal here because a query result is derived, not evidence.
Duplicate asserted from identical digests, citing both supporting observations.
The connector_123/124 trap resolved correctly: low confidence yields compare-set-with, not supersedes.
Heuristic generated-from at moderate confidence, pending a real generation run to pin inputs and tool version.
An unambiguous move: one file gone, one arrived, identical content, digest unique on both sides. Both endpoints carry the same digest, which is the whole basis for the claim.
cases.why_absent: A move's destination exists only after the move. The static fixture holds the pre-move tree, so the origin is checked against it and the destination cannot be.

cases.rationale: Advisory finding whose remediation is a proposal requiring approval.

cases.violates: Logical identity is a projection and must never appear on a raw observation.
A content digest was recorded under a policy that forbids reading content.
A machine-suggested supersedes at confidence 0.35 with no explanation. Gyst must never conclude supersession from a numeric suffix alone.
Empty evidence array. A derived record that cannot cite evidence must not exist.
Status is waived with no waiver record. A waiver is an audit record, not a status flag.
A rule waived its own finding. Only a human may waive.
